mechanic: Absence as evidence (idea 7): a watchman must punch his clock every hour from twelve until five, and the card has twelve, one, two, four and five. "Something is missing here" (move m, on the rule or a punch) puts the reader's own entry "no round at three" on the timeline; it is required evidence, and against the watchman's statement that he made every round it is a contradiction by itself (a denial against what it denies).
note: Spoilers. The logic written before the prose (docs/authored-stories.md, outline E). `frame` is what the narrator's own prose always carries; `clues` are the units that could be case files (here the card is one: files/card.txt). `facts` names the world model's facts that realise a clue. The outline's publican (the watchman in his back room from before three until nearly four) would have given the watchman an alibi for the very hour, and is left out.
